//: Coverage across ALL THREE api suites in one run, so a service covered only by its *.db-spec.ts, or a controller covered only by app.e2e-spec.ts, is not reported as untested (DN-54). Needs Postgres, like `npm run test:db`. Two projects rather than two runs: Jest merges the coverage natively, which avoids reconciling two reports. On coverageThreshold below -- RATCHET, NEVER TARGET: those numbers sit just under the coverage measured when they were set, so it cannot silently regress; they are not a goal. Raise them in the PR that raises coverage. Lowering one is a decision to state in the PR description, never a quiet edit to make CI pass.
